buildSteps.title: Consultation & site visit
buildSteps.body: We study your plot, your family’s needs and your budget before anything is drawn.

buildSteps.title: Design & 3D approval
buildSteps.body: Floor plans, structure drawings and 3D views are finalised with you.

buildSteps.title: Foundation & grey structure
buildSteps.body: Excavation, foundations, columns, slabs and brickwork with tested materials.

buildSteps.title: Electrical & plumbing
buildSteps.body: Concealed conduits and pipelines are laid and pressure-tested before plaster.

buildSteps.title: Finishing
buildSteps.body: Flooring, woodwork, paint, fittings and lighting, checked room by room.

buildSteps.title: Handover
buildSteps.body: A final snag-free inspection, then the keys — with written warranty.

services.title: Turnkey Luxury Construction
services.summary: Complete conceptualization, structural engineering, procurement and handover with zero hassle.
details: Blueprint, soil testing & structural engineering vetted by certified PEC consultants
Grey structure with deformed Grade 60 steel and high-spec A-grade concrete
Imported tiles, Spanish porcelain, custom woodwork & architectural lighting
Written warranty on structure, plumbing and electricals at handover

services.title: Engineered Grey Structure
services.summary: Rock-solid foundations, earthquake-resistant RCC columns and durable moisture barrier envelopes.
details: Rigorous excavation, subterranean waterproofing and anti-termite soil treatment
Seismic-resistant column-beam framing with Grade 60 steel reinforcement
Branded OPC cement with slump testing on every pour
Concealed electrical conduit & plumbing lines pressure-tested before plastering

services.title: Dual-Elevation & 3D Architectural Design
services.summary: Signature dual-side panoramic facades, cantilever terraces and organic stone elevations.
details: Photorealistic 3D external & internal renders before breaking ground
Dual-side elevation maximizing cross-ventilation, daylight and corner prominence
Energy-efficient insulated cavity walls and acoustic double-glazed glass
Travertine cladding, aluminum louvers and weather-resistant textures

services.title: Luxury Interior Fitouts & Smart Living
services.summary: Bespoke carpentry, ambient cove lighting, imported sanitary ware and home automation.
details: Pocket libraries, private acoustic home cinemas and open-plan kitchen atriums
Concealed VRF inverter climate conditioning and smart thermostats
Smart switches, motorized drapes and biometric smart door locks
Custom cabinetry, solid ash-wood doors and quartz stone countertops

spaces.title: Living Room
spaces.subtitle: Designed to impress, built to feel like home.
spaces.intro: The living room is where guests form their first impression and where the family spends its evenings. We plan it around light, seating and a feature wall that sets the tone for the whole house.
spaces.imageAlt: Open living room with curved furniture and natural stone

photos.alt: Open living room with curved furniture and natural stone

points: Feature walls in stone, wood panelling or textured paint
False ceilings with concealed cove lighting
Large windows placed for daylight and cross-ventilation
Media wall, storage and seating planned together

spaces.title: Bedroom
spaces.subtitle: Calm, private rooms made for real rest.
spaces.intro: Bedrooms are designed to be quiet and uncluttered — with the wardrobe, bed wall and lighting planned before construction, so nothing looks added later.
points: Custom wardrobes and walk-in closets
Upholstered or panelled bed-back walls
Warm layered lighting with bedside controls
Attached bathroom and dressing area planning

spaces.title: Bathroom
spaces.subtitle: Clean lines, quality fittings and easy upkeep.
spaces.intro: A good bathroom is about what you do not see — proper slopes, waterproofing and pressure-tested pipelines — finished with tiles and fittings that stay looking new.
points: Full-height tiling with waterproofing underneath
Vanity units with stone tops and mirror lighting
Glass shower enclosures and concealed fittings
Quality sanitary ware and proper ventilation

spaces.title: Kitchen
spaces.subtitle: Planned around the way your family cooks.
spaces.intro: From the working triangle to the last drawer, the kitchen is laid out for daily use first — and then finished to look as good as the rest of the house.
points: Modular cabinetry with soft-close hardware
Quartz or granite countertops
Built-in hob, hood and appliance spaces
Separate dirty kitchen and store where the plan allows

spaces.title: Basement
spaces.subtitle: Extra space for family, guests and entertainment.
spaces.intro: A basement adds a whole floor of usable space. We build it dry, bright and well ventilated, ready for a lounge, home cinema, gym or guest suite.
points: Full waterproofing and drainage protection
Light wells and ventilation for a fresh, bright space
Lounge, cinema, gym or guest suite layouts
Separate entrance options for privacy

spaces.title: Ground Area
spaces.subtitle: Lawn, porch and outdoor sitting that welcome you home.
spaces.intro: The ground area is the first thing you see when the gate opens. Lawn, car porch, driveway and outdoor sitting are designed together with the elevation of the house.
spaces.imageAlt: Front lawn and porch of a house
points: Landscaped lawn with planters and lighting
Car porch and driveway in stone or pavers
Outdoor sitting and BBQ corners
Boundary wall and gate designed to match the elevation

spaces.title: Pocket Library
spaces.subtitle: A quiet space where knowledge and design live in perfect harmony.
spaces.intro: A small reading corner or a full study wall — a pocket library gives the house a quiet place to read, work and think.
spaces.imageAlt: Warm wood-lined reading room with shelves and soft seating

photos.alt: Warm wood-lined reading room with shelves and soft seating

points: Built-in wooden shelving with integrated lighting
Comfortable reading seat or study desk
Acoustic treatment for a quiet room

spaces.title: Private Cinema
spaces.subtitle: Your own world. Your own screen. Your own rules.
spaces.intro: A dedicated cinema room with proper sound treatment, deep seating and lighting that dims with the opening scene.
spaces.imageAlt: Home cinema room with deep sofas and ambient cove lighting

photos.alt: Home cinema room with deep sofas and ambient cove lighting

points: Acoustic wall panels and sound insulation
Projector or large-screen setup with concealed wiring
Recliner seating and ambient cove lighting

spaces.title: Study Room
spaces.subtitle: A quiet corner for work, reading and focus.
spaces.intro: A private study planned with proper daylight, built-in shelving and a desk wall, so work stays out of the way of family life.
spaces.imageAlt: Study room with built-in desk and shelving
points: Built-in desk and shelving planned with the room
Daylight placement and task lighting
Concealed cable routing for computers and printers

living-room.title: Layout
living-room.body: Seating is arranged around conversation and the media wall, with clear walking space to the dining and drawing areas.

living-room.title: Materials
living-room.body: Porcelain or marble flooring, wood and stone feature walls, and paint tones chosen to match your furniture.

living-room.title: Lighting
living-room.body: Cove lights, spotlights and a statement fixture on separate switches, so the mood changes from day to evening.

bedroom.title: Layout
bedroom.body: Bed, wardrobe and dressing positions are fixed at drawing stage so switches and sockets land exactly where you need them.

bedroom.title: Materials
bedroom.body: Warm flooring, panelled or upholstered bed walls and wardrobes finished to match the doors.

bedroom.title: Comfort
bedroom.body: Attached bathroom, good daylight, and planned AC and fan positions for quiet, even cooling.

bathroom.title: Behind the tiles
bathroom.body: Waterproofing, correct floor slopes and pressure-tested pipelines are completed before any tile is fixed.

bathroom.title: Materials
bathroom.body: Full-height tiles, stone vanity tops and fittings selected for long life and easy cleaning.

bathroom.title: Details
bathroom.body: Mirror lighting, niches for storage, glass shower partitions and proper exhaust ventilation.

kitchen.title: Layout
kitchen.body: Sink, stove and fridge are placed for easy movement, with counter space on both sides of the hob.

kitchen.title: Materials
kitchen.body: Moisture-resistant cabinetry, quartz or granite tops and easy-clean splashbacks.

kitchen.title: Two kitchens
kitchen.body: A show kitchen for the family and a separate working kitchen keep the heavy cooking out of sight.

basement.title: Dry and safe
basement.body: Retaining walls, waterproofing and drainage are engineered first — a basement must stay dry for life.

basement.title: Light and air
basement.body: Light wells, ventilation and ceiling height are planned so the floor never feels underground.

basement.title: Use
basement.body: Lounge, cinema, gym, guest suite or storage — laid out around how your family will actually use it.

ground-area.title: Arrival
ground-area.body: Gate, driveway and porch are designed with the elevation so the house looks complete from the street.

ground-area.title: Lawn
ground-area.body: Lawn levels, planters and drainage are set during construction, not left for later.

ground-area.title: Outdoor living
ground-area.body: Sitting corners, lighting and paving that make the outdoor area usable in the evening.

pocket-library.title: Placement
pocket-library.body: A quiet corner off the lounge or landing, away from the television and the kitchen.

pocket-library.title: Joinery
pocket-library.body: Floor-to-ceiling wooden shelving with integrated lighting and a reading seat or desk.

private-cinema.title: Sound
private-cinema.body: Acoustic panels and insulated walls keep the sound inside the room and the rest of the house quiet.

private-cinema.title: Comfort
private-cinema.body: Stepped recliner seating, dimmable cove lighting and concealed wiring for projector and speakers.
